title: Archive session on turns with no code changes
description: autocommit.sh Stop hook exits early when the tree is clean (or only .beads churn), so discussion-only turns leave no session archive. Make the hook block in that case too and tell Claude to run /kix:save-session --no-commit, then commit the archive itself. Must use kix:save-session, not anthropic-skills:save-session (the latter opens a PR).
close_reason: Stop hook now blocks on clean-tree turns with an archive-only instruction

title: Enable kix plugin globally so every session archives itself
description: The Stop autocommit hook prefers /kix:commit, which calls /kix:save-session --no-commit so the session archive rides along in the same commit (no branch, no PR). But kix@kix-agents is only enabled at project scope for Stingdom, so every other project falls back to caveman:caveman-commit and no session archive is written. Enable kix@kix-agents in the global claude/settings.json enabledPlugins.

title: Auto-commit every turn via Stop hook
description: Commit progress once per prompt so history doubles as a progress log. Stop hook injects a commit instruction that routes to kix:commit first, caveman:caveman-commit second, inline Conventional Commits last. Guards skip mid-rebase/merge, clean trees, non-repos, beads-only churn, and re-entry.

title: make install: back up existing files before overwriting
description: make install clobbered installed copies with no way back, and 'all' ran clean+install. Move every install target into ~/.dotfiles-backups/<timestamp>/ first (doubles as the removal step), and make install the default goal.
close_reason: Timestamped backup in ~/.dotfiles-backups, install is default goal, all target dropped

title: Track global ~/.claude settings and hooks in dotfiles
description: ~/.claude/settings.json and the code-review hook scripts live only on this machine. Copy them into the repo under claude/ and wire them into make install/clean/update so they replicate to other setups.

title: Rebind aerospace alt shortcuts que colidem com dead keys
description: alt-a (layout accordion/tiles) e workspace O colidem com digitacao de acentos no macOS: alt-e/alt-n sao dead keys e o alt fica segurado, disparando alt-a e alt-o. 'ao' (alt-n + o) e frequentissimo em portugues. Fix: alt-a -> alt-t (tiles), workspace O -> letra livre que nunca segue dead key (g/q/v/w/y).
close_reason: alt-a -> alt-t, workspace O -> G; aplicado e recarregado

title: cmd-ctrl-c opens a duplicate Claude instance
description: orbit open searched only the focused workspace for Claude for Desktop, then fell through to the generic fallback. Claude's AppleScript 'make new window' fails with -2710, so orbit ran 'open -nb', which forces a second app instance instead of revealing the existing window.

title: ai-jail-worktree: mount main worktree's .beads as rw
description: When running claude/codex from a git worktree via the `cl`/`cx` aliases, the sandbox needs read-write access to the main worktree's `.beads/` directory so beads can read/write the shared issue database. Currently `ai-jail-worktree` only mounts `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` (the `.git/` dir), which doesn't cover the sibling `.beads/` directory. Update the function in `zshrc` to also `--rw-map` `<main_root>/.beads` when present.

title: Add sketchybar with workspaces and stats only
description: Imported from https://github.com/kelvinst/dotfiles/issues/6. Set up sketchybar limited to workspace indicators and system stats.

title: Use Brewfile to install system deps
description: Imported from https://github.com/kelvinst/dotfiles/issues/7. Manage system dependencies via a Brewfile so dotfiles bootstrap can install everything reproducibly.

title: Try out ghostty
description: Imported from https://github.com/kelvinst/dotfiles/issues/5. Evaluate ghostty as a terminal alternative.
